visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black-rimmed glasses and a black t-shirt is seen in an indoor studio environment with bright white lighting. He holds two large rectangular boxes featuring cartoon graphics of Tom and Jerry; one box is primarily red and gold, while the other is white and green. He moves them toward the camera to show the front artwork. (2) Close-up shots of two blocky, cube-shaped figurines are shown. The first is a brown mouse character with large ears and a smiling face, shaped like a cube. The second is a grey cat character with a fierce expression, also shaped like a cube with white paws protruding. Both objects are placed against a plain light-colored background. (3) The man holds a new figurine featuring a mouse character in a pink and yellow traditional Chinese hat, sitting atop a white cube that resembles a piece of cheese with green light emanating from holes. The cube has a large green character '發' on the front. He points to the mouse's hands, which hold small orange rectangular objects. (4) The man displays a second version of the figurine where the cheese block is golden-yellow with a large brown '發' character. He rotates the golden cube to reveal a logo on the back while the first white version sits beside it on a flat table surface. He brings the golden one close to the lens to show the metallic texture and glitter. (5) The man takes both figurines and places them on a light wood-grained shelf which appears to be a shoe cabinet. He adjusts their positions side-by-side. A graphic overlay with a black and orange lion-head logo and Chinese text appears on the screen as he looks into the camera and speaks.
